rules.statement: A fidei commissum created for the descendants of devisees extends to at least the fourth generation, unless the will explicitly restricts it otherwise.
rules.supporting_quote: "The word 'descendants' may in its narrowest sense be used to denote 'children' and 'children' only, but the usual sense in which it is used implies descent in its successive steps, and I have not the least doubt that is the way in which the notary used it in this will."
